misreadings.quote: the 'cleaner' who saw the truth is sacked
misreadings.evidence: "Tonight she gets sacked", said Mr. Samsa
misreadings.explanation: Mr. Samsa only says she will be sacked that night, so presenting it as already done is wrong; the translation's "has been sacked to remove the last trace of their shame" also invents a motive the text does not give.

result.note: Nearly all of the reflection's claims about the text are accurate or framed as interpretation; the only clear error is treating the cleaner's dismissal, which Mr. Samsa only announces as a future intention, as already carried out.
